item.tib: zab lam mkha' 'gro 'bum rdzogs ma rgyud gsas mkhar sde lnga'i rgyud phyag
item.coloph: zhes ma rgyud gsas mkhar sde lnga'i thugs sgrub man ngag gnad 'dus kyi rgyud phyag nyung 'dus 'di ni spa ston tshul khrims dbang rgyal gyis lha rdzas kyi mtshams sbyar nas gsung gis bskul ngor bka' gsung mi ldog tsam du shag rigs bla ming kun grags ming nas bris pa bstan pa'i cha rkyen du gyur cig/
